# relay_cloud_integration_setup (Data Source)

What an IAM role needs for Relay to assume it: the trust policy and external ID for the role, and the S3 permissions to attach to it. Reading it needs permission to create cloud integrations in the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_cloud_integration_setup" "aws" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace the integration will belong to.

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider. Only `aws`, the default, is available.

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) External ID Relay presents when assuming the role. It is the same for every integration in the organization.
- `permissions_policy` (String) Permissions policy JSON for the role. It names the bucket `YOUR_BUCKET`; replace it with the export bucket, for example with `replace()`.
- `relay_aws_account_id` (String) AWS account Relay assumes the role from.
- `trust_policy` (String) Trust policy JSON for the role's `assume_role_policy`.
